label: Updated at 8 p.m. ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Todd Clements Leads Corales Puntacana
items.text: Todd Clements is tied for the lead at -7 after finishing his round, alongside Ivan Cantero Gutierrez, with Austin Eckroat and Alejandro Del Rey close behind at -6.

items.headline: Jackson Suber Leads The Open Championship
items.text: Jackson Suber holds the solo lead at -5 after completing his round at The Open Championship, with Sungjae Im and Dan Brown trailing one shot behind.

items.headline: Bryson DeChambeau Challenges Nick Faldo
items.text: After opening The Open with a 3-under 67, Bryson DeChambeau defended his strategic play against Nick Faldo's criticism, putting him just one shot off the lead and back in contention.
